name: Quantum Electronics
description: Blackbody radiation, photoelectric effect, wave-particle duality, basic postulates of QM, wavefunctions, probability interpretation; Schrödinger equation (time-independent), linear operators, eigenvalues, eigenfunctions, expectation values, uncertainty principle, density matrix formalism; two-level systems as qubits, superposition and measurement, Bloch sphere, pure and mixed states, density matrix representation of qubits; quantum logic gates (X, Y, Z, H, CNOT), quantum circuit models, gate operations (single and two-qubit), universal gate sets, introduction to quantum algorithms; Qubit platforms (photonic, superconducting, trapped ions, semiconductor quantum dots), emission of quantum light, indistinguishability, photon entanglement, telecom-wavelength sources; BB84 and BBM92 protocols, quantum teleportation, entanglement swapping, basic introduction to QKD hardware; Rabi oscillations, Ramsey fringes, pulse sequences (π, π/2), state readout techniques, decoherence and noise in qubit systems (T1, T2 times); Coulomb blockade, single electron transistors (SETs), quantum dots for qubit control, charge sensing, spin qubits, readout and gating; fault-tolerant quantum computing, error correction basics, current quantum processor architectures, emerging semiconductor quantum systems, Indian and global research landscape.
